mechanism.claim: An unusually large standardized VXN change relative to the median standardized change in VIX, GVZ, and OVX isolates Nasdaq volatility leadership rather than a common volatility move. In a high-variation BTC regime, fade that idiosyncratic leadership for twelve elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: negative strict sign of leadership_residual; no BTC direction confirmation
mechanism.why_distinct: NVXCR used raw VXN-versus-VIX rotation with BTC confirmation, cross-asset breadth used four-index signs, and the equity-commodity residual used equal-weight raw changes. NVLRR instead compares independently standardized VXN change with the median of three independently standardized non-Nasdaq volatility-index changes.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: BTC prior-24h realized-variation strict-prior decision rank must be at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: Gross9 has no exact standardized VXN-versus-VIX/GVZ/OVX leadership residual clock

features.common_source_dates: exact intersection of source dates having one positive finite close for each of VIX, VXN, GVZ, and OVX
features.index_changes: for each index independently, log(close on current exact common source date / close on previous exact common source date)

index_zscores.history: H_i(S) is at most 252 strictly prior common-date changes for index i; minimum 126; current change excluded
index_zscores.validity: all history changes must be finite and sample_std with ddof=1 must be finite and strictly positive; otherwise S is ineligible

absolute_leadership_rank.history: at most 252 strictly prior valid common-source-date absolute leadership residuals; minimum 126; current excluded

features.availability: source date S close is usable only at 09:30 America/New_York on the next exact common Cboe source date D
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum(log(close/open)^2)) over the exact 1440 unique BTCUSDT 1m rows in [D 09:30 America/New_York-24 elapsed hours,D 09:30 America/New_York)

btc_variation_rank.history: at most 252 strictly prior valid decision variations; minimum 126; current excluded

features.missing_duplicate_nonpositive_or_nonfini: source failure or ineligible as applicable; no imputation

clock.decision: next exact common Cboe source date D at 09:30 America/New_York, after source S and the exact prior-24h BTC variation path are available
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty passes

rv20_stress_slice.rv20: sqrt(365*mean exact daily returns^2 over t-20 through t-1)
rv20_stress_slice.threshold: numpy linear q90 over 756 strictly prior available RV20 observations
rv20_stress_slice.future_use: only after all sequential full-calendar stages and economics pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final and strict economics

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent standardized Nasdaq-volatility leadership mechanism frozen without candidate incidence, outcomes, or Gross9 results

stopping_rule: terminal first failure: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics, then RV20 audit; no source, zscore, residual, rank, side, hold, clock, volatility, subset, comparator, or control repair
